DPL optimizes net-Sharpe end-to-end so Sigma is auxiliary (DPL does not require a pre-estimated Sigma as a hard input), but this package supplies: (1) candidate-universe Sigma for any covariance-aware DPL regularizer / risk-budget overlay, (2) residual orthogonality of the 3 new features (Codex alpha critique #4 directly addressed), (3) crowding_score_per_factor, (4) tail/stress diagnostics so DPL net-Sharpe objective does not silently ignore tail.

crowding_flags: NETISSUE__lvl crowding_score 0.785 >= 0.75 -> FLAG (but driven by HHI of narrow top-20 within 96% coverage; passive_overlap_proxy=1 is a constant ceiling artifact since all candidates are in_univ — true passive crowding NOT separable in panel-only data)
MOHANRAM__lvl crowding_score 0.749 (borderline; HHI 0.307 inflated by 18.6% low-BM coverage subset -> small effective pool, NOT genuine institutional crowding)
risk_summary.crowding_methodology_caveat: Full Acadian 2026 crowding (crowding_score_per_factor.R) requires RAWDATA daily Vol/Size + institutional flow; the DPL panel (sanctioned input) carries only monthly adv. Computed panel-native proxy. passive_overlap_proxy is a CONSTANT 1.0 (all candidates in_univ) -> contributes a flat 0.25 to every score, so absolute scores are upward-biased; RANK across factors is the usable signal. momentum (M05) crowding 0.556 is the genuinely tradable-volume-crowded axis (vol_concentration 0.220, highest). The 2 new-feature 'flags' are coverage/HHI artifacts, not institutional crowding -> advisory only.
liquidity_flags: Sigma universe restricted to lockbox cross-section with adv >= 5e7 KRW (request liquidity floor); 239 names with >=60mo history retained from 350.

gfc_2008.note: book coverage min 0.54 < 0.85 -> UNRELIABLE (partial KQ150 listing in 2008-09); positive value is a coverage artifact, DISREGARD

covid_2020.note: EW candidate basket recovered fast (3mo window Feb-Apr 2020 net positive); short window

risk_summary.stress_note: These are HISTORICAL realized cumulative returns of the equal-weight candidate basket (descriptive, metric_type=proxy; NOT a contract build_bt_result and NOT the DPL portfolio). They bound the candidate pool's regime exposure, not the optimized DPL weights. Worst reliable scenario RateHike2022 -9.91%, within policy (no scenario < -10% on reliable windows).

diagnostics.shrinkage_method: ledoit_wolf_constant_corr + RF-R2 escalation (delta 0.37->0.95) + eigenvalue-floor ridge (cond# target <480)
diagnostics.sigma_caveat: N=239 ~ T=227 -> sample cov singular (cond# 1.18e18). LW analytic shrinkage alone insufficient (cond# 991 > 500 hard threshold), required RF-R2 escalation to delta=0.95 + eigenvalue floor to reach cond# 480 < 500. Sigma is heavily regularized (95% toward constant-correlation target) -> reliable for risk-budget / ranking but cross-name covariance detail is shrunk away. DPL does NOT require this Sigma as a hard input (net-Sharpe is learned end-to-end); supplied for optional covariance-aware regularization only.

panel_pca.interpretation: 98f panel has NO dominant common factor (PC1 only 10%) -> feature diversity is genuine, good for DPL (no single collinear mode to overfit).

residual_orthogonality.method: per-month cross-sectional OLS residualization of each new feature against [S01_Size, 5 value axes, log(adv) liquidity] structural style axes, then (a) residual variance share retained, (b) residual max|corr| vs base90, (c) era-stability of raw corr vs argmax-base, (d) unique variance = 1 - top5-PC communality. Directly addresses Codex alpha critique #4 (max-pairwise-corr insufficient).

PIOTROSKI__lvl.verdict: GENUINELY ORTHOGONAL — 87.5% of variance survives style neutralization, residual corr vs base90 only 0.21, 86% idiosyncratic info. Era corr stable & modest (0.17-0.30). Confirms alpha claim with stronger evidence than max-corr.

MOHANRAM__lvl.verdict: STRONGLY ORTHOGONAL — 96% variance survives, 96% idiosyncratic. Era corr DECAYING (0.32->0.06) i.e. increasingly independent. Coverage 18.6% caveat stands (signal lives in low-BM subset).

NETISSUE__lvl.verdict: ORTHOGONAL & STABLE — 93% survives, negative stable corr vs reversal axis (consistent issuance-reversal economics). 95% idiosyncratic.

RESIDMOM__lvl.verdict: REDUNDANT IN PANEL — even after style neutralization residual corr vs base90 stays 0.78, only 39.5% idiosyncratic, era corr vs M05_Trended_Mom rock-stable at 0.84-0.87 across ALL eras. Confirms alpha RF-A-c2-2: residmom's cycle1 orthogonality was vs the R05 BOOK not the feature PANEL. RISK RECOMMENDS DROP from DPL panel (collinear -> overfit risk).

tail_risk.metric_type: proxy (EW candidate basket monthly, pre-lockbox; NOT DPL portfolio)
tail_risk.interpretation: GPD shape xi=0.23 > 0 -> heavy-tailed (finite but fat). Hill alpha 2.69 (<3) -> 3rd moment borderline-infinite, fat left tail typical of KR equity. ES95 -13.3% monthly. DPL caveat: net-Sharpe-only objective is tail-blind; a DPL solution maximizing Sharpe can still carry ES95 ~-13% — RECOMMEND optimizer add a CVaR/ES penalty or report DPL portfolio ES alongside Sharpe (does NOT override DPL, advisory).

regime_correlation.note: Cross-sectional dispersion is HIGHER in RALLY (0.152) than CRISIS (0.121) -> in KR crises names move TOGETHER (corr up, dispersion compressed) = classic crisis correlation spike. DPL trained on full sample may under-hedge crisis co-movement. CRISIS n=14 small -> regime-conditional Sigma would be noisy; pooled Sigma used (reproducibility over thin bootstrap, per risk-style guidance).

factor_correlation_warnings: RESIDMOM__lvl vs M05_Trended_Mom__lvl: corr 0.847 raw, 0.781 style-neutralized residual, era-stable 0.84-0.87 -> persistent collinearity (RF-R5).

dpl_handoff.for_optimizer: DPL c2 sweep (cvxpylayers, weight_method DPL). Risk inputs: (1) covariance.parquet (cond# 480, PSD, heavily shrunk — use only if covariance-aware DPL variant) (2) PRUNE RESIDMOM__lvl + 4 __slp from panel (collinear/noise -> overfit) -> recommended DPL panel = base90 + PIOTROSKI__lvl + MOHANRAM__lvl + NETISSUE__lvl = ~93f (3) tail: report DPL portfolio ES95 alongside net-Sharpe; consider ES/CVaR penalty (4) crisis co-movement: cross-sec dispersion compresses in CRISIS -> DPL Sharpe-only may under-hedge; suggest subperiod-min as graduation guard (already in calmar/oos_retention gates).
dpl_handoff.ceiling_view_from_risk: Risk-side honest assessment: nothing in the risk structure suggests a ceiling BREAKOUT. (a) The 3 new features ARE genuinely orthogonal (resid var 0.87-0.96) so they DO add independent information — this is the necessary condition for DPL to help. BUT (b) orthogonal information with weak long-side transfer (top20 active t 0.7-1.4) + fat tail (ES95 -13%) + crisis correlation spike means the marginal Sharpe DPL can extract is bounded. (c) The candidate basket's own tail/stress (worst reliable -9.9%, ES99 -20.7%) caps risk-adjusted upside. (d) avg pairwise corr 0.156 = a hard common-mode floor that long-only cannot diversify below. Risk verdict: orthogonality REFUTES the 'no new info' worry but does NOT support SR 2.5; consistent with alpha+Codex independent view that 1.74 breakout is unproven. Definitive judgment is the optimizer full DPL sweep (forge-authoritative), not risk.
